places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Peach finds Elmira's cabin empty; the town hounds Roscoe, who reluctantly rides off to find July, leaving the army post half a mile away to guard town.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: The ferryman tells Roscoe a woman boarded the whiskey traders' boat heading upriver days after July left.
places.location_hint: at Fort Smith; the whiskey boat went upstream

places.name: Bent's Fort
places.note: Destination of the whiskey traders' boat Elmira apparently took.

places.name: Catfish Grove
places.note: Nearest town, unremarkable; a bear once took a baby from a cabin near it.
places.location_hint: about fourteen miles from Fort Smith, Arkansas

places.name: Texas
places.note: July has gone there; Roscoe heads that way at chapter's end to tell him Elmira left.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: July and Joe are believed headed there; Peach tells Roscoe to ask along the way.

places.name: Mississippi
places.note: Old Mrs. Harkness once taught school somewhere there.

places.name: Little Rock
places.note: Roscoe's only prior trip, a miserable ride in cold rain that left him feverish for a month.

places.name: Memphis
places.note: Roscoe's hometown, after which he named his tall white gelding.

places.name: California
places.note: Peach jokes Roscoe will end up there if he misses July.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Peach says Elmira will reach it before Roscoe gets going.

groups.label: Roscoe Brown
groups.hint: just riding out of town on Memphis, heading for Texas to find July

groups.label: Elmira
groups.hint: apparently aboard a whiskey boat bound upriver toward Bent's Fort, left several days ago

groups.label: Fort Smith townsfolk
groups.hint: at the jail seeing Roscoe off
